concerns.text: Task T021 implements MDES via 'noise injection' (Gaussian noise on labels). This violates spec FR-006 which explicitly mandates simulating an alternative hypothesis by 'swapping top-k positions'. The task silently relaxes the required mechanism without spec amendment.

Task T015 triggers subsampling if runtime > 5 hours. Spec FR-011 and Plan.md (Runtime & Memory Budget) mandate subsampling if runtime > 3.5 hours (to ensure total < 6h). This task relaxes the safety threshold, risking violation of FR-009 (≤6h total runtime).

Task T038 requires updating state YAML with artifact hashes but lacks the implementation step to compute the hash and write the file. This is a semantic weakening of Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) which requires artifacts to carry content hashes; the task describes the goal but not the deliverable.

Task T004 mandates a fallback to 'NIST archive paths' if HuggingFace fails. Spec FR-001 requires downloading from 'without requiring authentication' (implied HuggingFace/official mirror). The plan mentions NIST as a fallback, but the task hardcodes a specific fallback mechanism not explicitly defined in the spec's FR-001 text, potentially introducing an unverified data source path not covered by the spec's verification gate.
